title: 新时代的年轻人
en: Young People of a New Age

sents.zh: 一百年以前，中国有很多年轻人。
sents.en: A hundred years ago China had many young people.

sents.zh: 他们和以前的年轻人很不一样。
sents.en: They were very different from those before them.

sents.zh: 学校里教数学，也教西边的学问。
sents.en: The schools taught mathematics, and western learning.

sents.zh: 有的人还去别的国家读书。
sents.en: Some even went abroad to study.
They lived overseas for some years.

sents.zh: 因为看到了很多新东西，所以他们想得更多了。
sents.en: Because they saw so much that was new, they thought more deeply.

sents.zh: 学好了以后，很多人回来了。
有的人做老师，有的人做医生。
他们做事情的方法和以前不一样。
sents.en: Their way of doing things was not the old way.

sents.zh: 他们写新的书，用大家都懂的话。
sents.en: They wrote new books, in language everyone could understand.

sents.zh: 因为这样，读书的人越来越多。
sents.en: Because of this, more and more people could read.

sents.zh: 他们也做新的东西，问新的问题。
sents.en: They made new things and asked new questions.

sents.zh: 他们想让自己的国家好起来。
sents.en: They wanted to make their country better.

sents.zh: 他们说：读书可以改变一个国家。
sents.en: They said: study can change a country.
